_doc: One LiteLLM virtual key per consumer. The key values come from the env (1Password item llm-gateway via externalsecret.yaml); budgets and limits are set from here on every sync, so git is the source of truth. budget_usd is per budget_duration.

keys.consumer: iso-lab miso-api: the lab's Ask (public pages)
miso-ask: the raw chat (Open WebUI, admin only)
